scripts.build: npm run build -w @bridge/protocol && npm run build -w @bridge/relay && npm run build -w @bridge/client && npm run build:bundle -w @bridge/desktop && npm run prepare:from-client -w @bridge/mobile
scripts.dev: concurrently -n relay,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @bridge/relay" "npm run dev -w @bridge/client"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n relay,web,desktop -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @bridge/relay" "npm run dev -w @bridge/client" "wait-on tcp:5188 tcp:8788 && npm run dev -w @bridge/desktop"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
